title: $15K a month. Built in 12 hours.
subtitle: He can't really code. Here's exactly what he did.

title: It does one boring thing.
subtitle: You talk, it listens, and AI turns your rambling into clean writing. He called it AudioPen.

title: 12 hours. No code.
body: He built it in a half-day hackathon on Bubble, a no-code tool, wired to OpenAI for the smart part. Running cost: about $30 a month.
tip: No degree, no team, no funding. A weekend project with a payment button.

title: It worked on day one.
body: 100 paying customers in the first 48 hours. $73,000 in two months. Zero spent on ads.
tip: He launched to an audience he had built in public on X for months. Launch day was a warm crowd, not silence.

title: The AI was the cheap part.
subtitle: The model is a commodity. What made the money: a problem he understood and an audience that trusted him. Both were free.

title: Four moves, in order.
body: 1. Find a boring task people pay to do badly. 2. Start posting in public today. 3. Wrap it in a weekend with no-code plus AI. 4. Charge before it's finished.

title: What's your AudioPen?
subtitle: The most boring task at your job is probably the one worth wrapping. Save this, then go look.
